title: An Implicit Time-Domain Harmonic Balance Method for Radio-Frequency Capacitively Coupled Plasma Simulations
summary: Fast and accurate fluid simulation of radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasmas (RF CCPs) is of great importance for the iterative design and parameter optimization of modern plasma reactors. This study presents the first successful extension of the time-domain harmonic balance (HB) method to a fully coupled drift-diffusion-Poisson system with complete electron-energy transport for RF plasma simulations.
